title: Concurrent saved-capture opens can select a different item than the last click
reproduction: From a list with two Sources, click Source A, then click Source B before A’s getSavedCapture request returns.
Arrange for B’s request to return first and A’s request to return last.
Observe the detail selected after both requests complete.
expected: The detail view corresponds to the most recent row selection, Source B.
actual: openCapture has no request generation or selected-ID guard; each resolution calls setSelected, so the slower A response overwrites B.
severity: S3: delayed detail response can navigate to a stale capture
priority: P2: user sees the wrong saved Source after selecting another row
verification_status: Source-derived reproducible sequence; native and regression verification pending.
